title: SILVIA - Azimut Grande 30 Metri
highlights: Main-deck owner's suite with lounge, dressing room and study
description:
Delivered in 2018 and maintained to a high standard, SILVIA is a 29.1-metre Azimut Grande combining luxurious design with real performance. Her main-deck saloon blends silver oak floors, leather cabinetry and glass, supported by a sophisticated AV/IT system.

She sleeps six in three cabins: an exceptional owner's suite with king-size bed, private lounge, dressing room and study, plus two VIP doubles. With a flybridge Jacuzzi and twin 2,400 HP engines for 22 knots cruising, she is lying in Rimini, Italy.
